title: Layout
description: osu! HUD spots = each readout where osu!'s own HUD draws it (HP top-left, score/accuracy top-right, combo bottom-left; mania combo beside the stage). Use it with the in-game HUD hidden. stack = one column in the free band beside the playfield/stage (taiko: under the lane). strip = one row under the playfield or taiko lane (mania: beside the stage).

title: Side
description: Which free band stack and strip use. auto = right of the osu!/catch playfield, the roomier side of the mania stage, under the taiko lane (strip: centred). Ignored by osu! HUD spots.

title: Nudge X / px
description: Moves everything horizontally (1920×1080 px) for skins that place things differently.

title: Size
description: Scale factor, growing away from each readout's screen corner; clamped to 0.5–3.

title: Mania column width override
description: 0 = read ColumnWidth/ColumnSpacing from your current skin's skin.ini through vosu (stable default 30 when unavailable). Set a number (osu!stable virtual px) to override. Keeps mania readouts beside the stage.

title: Mania column start override
description: 0 = read ColumnStart from your skin (stable default 136 when unavailable). osu!lazer centres the stage and ignores this.

title: Backing
description: none = type floats on the game with a contrast shadow. scrim = a soft dark haze behind each readout, no edges. panel = the 18-LAB graphite panel.

title: Accent
description: Colour of the progress ring and combo rail: map = a tone derived from the beatmap background (18-LAB amber when it has no usable colour), 18-lab = always amber.

title: Score separators
description: Thousands separator for the score, e.g. 01,234,567 / 01.234.567 / 01 234 567. Leading zeros are dimmed.

title: Show combo
description: Large combo with a bump on every hit and a red break flash when the combo is lost. The rail under it shows combo against the map's max combo; the tick marks the peak this play.

title: Show rank letter
description: Small grade next to the accuracy. Silver (Hidden/Flashlight) grades use a filled chip.

title: Show HP
description: Health from /play/healthBar/normal (0–200) as a gauge and percentage; red under 25%.

title: Show progress ring
description: Map progress from first to last object, with the remaining time adjusted for rate mods.
